thread:
harper: Heads-up: kicking off a 2-week "stability sprint" for catalog lifecycle work. Goal: firm up onboarding gates, pin tiers, and a lightweight deprecation runway. Need decisions by next Fri so we can include in roadmap.
kevin: From infra/ops: propose hard gate list for onboarding: bench pass (p95/p99), smoke canary (24h), and capacity reservation flag if customer requests >60% traffic. Ops wants pin tiers tied to explicit reserve uplift numbers.
tess: ML bench proposals: p95 <= 250ms seq256 on Dedicated, p99 <= 520ms for heavy tails. Quality: embed R@10 >= 0.92 for retrieval; rerank MRR +4% over current best. Hallucination <= 2.0% on QA slice.
omar: Pin tier idea (naming to avoid legal confusion): brief (14d soft), steady (60d managed), anchor (120d contractual). Anchor requires signed addendum and ops capacity commit. For anchor, we promise no forced migration during window and 30d post-window notice.
sylvia: Pricing/finance: show reserved uplift per tier: brief +0%, steady +18%, anchor +35% (ballpark). Recommend a two-part charge: flat monthly pin fee + per-token uplift. We'll model sample customers.
kevin: Fallback rules: auto-fallback if p99 regresses >15% sustained for 2h OR error rate delta >0.7% absolute in 1h. Fallback target: last-stable or light-variant. Ops runbook will have manual approval paths for anchor pins.
tess: Bench harness snippet we'll share with teams:
```
# bench_check.py
bench.run(model="atlas-v1", sequences=[64,256], runs=800, metrics=["p95","p99","embed_r10","mrr","halluc_rate"])
```
harper: Instrumentation request: add dims model_version, pin_tier, migration_id, quant_variant, seq_bucket. Expose pin_tier in Console by default so we can slice rollbacks and latency by cohort.
sylvia: For deprecation runway: propose a minimum migration window policy: if model is deprecated, standard customers get 45d notice + opt-in canary; anchor customers get 90d notice and migration assistance. This should be codified in legal.
omar: Ops needs a simple canary recipe: 1) bench CI pass -> 2) internal 5% 24h -> 3) invited pilot customers 7d -> then widen. If any gate fails, auto-stop rollout and notify SRE/product pager.\e.g.:
```
# canary plan pseudo
step1: bench-pass
step2: deploy -> 5% internal -> monitor 24h
step3: if stable -> invite pilots -> monitor 7d
```
kevin: Owners: kevin -> ops runbook + fallback automation, tess -> bench harness + adversarial sets, sylvia -> pricing model + legal hooks, harper -> pilot invites + roadmap note. Deploy-bot will run the bench once PR lands.
deploy-bot: CI queued: bench-atlas-v1 -> 2026-03-25T14:00:00Z (gated).
harper: Decision requested: confirm anchor=120d, steady=60d, brief=14d and the uplift buckets so we can finalize pilot comms by EOD Thursday. If no objections I'll lock these defaults. :sparkles:
